title: Wikipedia-wave plate license ledger
note: Original Simplfy teaching notes. Wikipedia/Wikidata used as a glossary and related-graph, not as clinical protocol or as NIST-grade statistical definitional authority. Clinical regimen and dose grammar remain WHO then CDC. Stats definitions remain NIST e-Handbook and original Simplfy notes, then Wikipedia. No OpenStax. No PubMed abstracts as lesson text. No WHO logos. No copyrighted textbooks. Commons images were not hotlinked; visual specs are original SVG-style plate kinds already in the studio.
